about.title: 20 years. 1000+ students. One mission.
about.subtitle: Empowering women across Tamil Nadu through beauty.
about.story: Founded in 2006 in Ambattur, Chennai, Kalai's Beauty Care & Academy has grown from a single studio into one of the most trusted beauty schools in the city. For two decades we have trained over 1000 women — many of whom now run their own salons across Tamil Nadu.
about.mission: To empower 10,000+ women by 2030 to launch their own salons through professional training, hands-on practice and lifelong placement support.
about.founderBio: Kalaiselvi has spent two decades shaping Chennai's beauty landscape. A government-recognised certified educator and International Makeup Artist, she founded the academy with one mission: empower women through skill, confidence and craft.
